consequence.statement: The ScrapeConfig resource now exposes a read-only status subresource that displays configuration binding status and conditions when the StatusForConfigurationResources feature gate is enabled; this is a new optional field that does not affect existing configurations.

assertion.statement: The ScrapeConfig v1alpha1 CRD now includes a status subresource field with nested bindings, conditions, and related metadata fields for tracking configuration binding status.
